verses.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: dha(n)n dha(n)n satigur purakh nira(n)kaar aakaar banaiaa|

en.bdb: The formless Lord has assumed the form of true Guru, the blessed one.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਿ ਚਰਣਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਜੁ ਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: dha(n)n dha(n)n satigur sikh sun charan saran gursikh ju aaiaa|

en.bdb: Fortunate is the Sikh of the Guru who listening to the teaching of the Guru has sought the shelter of the Guru-feet.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh maarag dha(n)n hai saadhasa(n)gat mil sa(n)g chalaiaa|

en.bdb: The way of the gurmukhs is blessed on which one treads through the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਧੰਨੁ ਮਸਤਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: dha(n)n dha(n)n satigur charan dha(n)n masatak gur charanee laiaa|

en.bdb: Blest is feet of the true Guru and that head is also fortunate which reposes on the feet of Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪਰਸਣਿ ਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: satigur dharasan dha(n)n hai dha(n)n dha(n)n gursikh parasan aaiaa|

en.bdb: The glimpse of the true Guru is auspicious and the Sikh of the Guru is also blessed one who has come to have sight of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੁਹਿ ਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: bhaau bhagat gursikh vich hoi dhiaal gur muh laiaa|

en.bdb: The Guru loves happily the devotional feelings of the Sikh.
The wisdom of the Guru decimates duality.
